item.title: Nagasaki Atomic Bomb Museum — Guide
item.description: The Nagasaki Atomic Bomb Museum, beside the Peace Park, tells the story of the atomic bombing of the city on 9 August 1945 and its aftermath. Through harrowing photographs, scorched and melted artefacts — a stopped clock frozen at 11:02, twisted metal, everyday objects deformed by the heat — as well as survivor (hibakusha) testimony, models and film, it conveys both the scale of the destruction and the intensely human tragedy of the day.
